decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the established machining offer and fits the firm's announced push toward smarter automation, so management will defend the investment even though the website gives it only modest visibility.

The dual-table loading system is a low-cost, close-to-core automation accessory that supports the firm's automation strategy, and there is no sign of failure that would justify reversing a recent launch.

The firm has committed heavily and publicly to the dispensing machine through its own web page and a Red Dot award, so any early weak sales would be blamed on market build-up rather than seen as grounds to drop it.
